context: Riku asks Asuka about becoming a researcher.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: career chat; vocabulary (博士/研究所/証明/単語/翻訳) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 将来、博士になりたいんです。
lines.en: I want to become a doctor (PhD) someday.
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 素敵な夢ですね。研究所で働けますよ。
lines.en: A lovely dream. You could work at an institute.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 英語の単語、もっと覚えなきゃ。
lines.en: I have to learn more English words.
lines.style: determined teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 単語を増やせば、翻訳も楽になります。
lines.en: More words make translation easier too.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 翻訳の仕事も、面白そうですね。
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 研究所では、翻訳も大切な仕事です。
lines.en: At an institute, translation is important work too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 自分の力を、証明したいです。
lines.en: I want to prove my abilities.
lines.style: resolved teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 努力は、いつか必ず証明されますよ。
lines.en: Effort is always proven in the end.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm encouraging closing clarity throughout
